chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Musanna al-Hannat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the adulterer when he is whipped the Hadd (penalty). He said: 'He is exiled from the land to a town where he will remain for a year.'
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for an adulterer after receiving the Hadd in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the post-punishment exile (Nafy) for the Zani, specifying a one-year duration in a different town to ensure social reintegration and deterrence. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is often discussed alongside the debate on whether exile is a distinct punishment or an administrative measure, with scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Mufid and Al-Tusi providing detailed analyses on its application.
